user.title: Connect to LTEK
user.description: Create a personal API token on your LTEK profile page and paste it here. A token only works on the server it was created on.

data_description.server: Production is api.ltek.dk. Development is only for testing new features.
data_description.token: Starts with ltk_. It is stored only in Home Assistant.

custom_url.title: Custom server
custom_url.description: Base URL of the LTEK API, without /api/v1.

data_description.url: Must use https, unless the server runs on this machine (localhost).

reconfigure.title: Replace token
reconfigure.description: Replace the token for this account. To use another server or account, add a new entry instead.

reconfigure_url.title: Custom server
reconfigure_url.description: Base URL of the LTEK API, without /api/v1.

reauth_confirm.title: Token no longer accepted
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} was revoked or has expired. Create a new one on your LTEK profile page for the same account.

error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the token, or the token has no access to trackers.
error.invalid_token_format: An LTEK API token starts with ltk_ and contains only letters, digits, - and _.
error.invalid_url: Not a valid URL. Use https:// (http:// only for localhost).

abort.already_configured: This account on this server is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different account or server. To use another server or account, add a new entry.
